description: This file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments and environment variables, specifically designed for argument consumption and flag handling in a Node.js environment.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads an environment variable, trims it, and parses it into a floating point number if valid.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and, if so, returns the next argument as its value.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and returns the associated string value.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and, if so, parses the following argument as an integer with optional bounds.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag and, if so, parses the following argument as a float with optional bounds.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer that assigns a string value to a key when the flag is encountered.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer that appends a string value to a list associated with a key when the flag is encountered.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer that assigns an integer value to a key when the flag is encountered, with optional min bound.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer that assigns a float value to a key when the flag is encountered, with optional bounds.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer that sets a boolean key to true (or specified value) when the flag is present.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments based on specified flag handlers, handling unknown options and supporting ignore double dash option.
